fusions.name: Fistful of Scruff
fusions.desc: Grabs the target and butts it for 14 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Rearing Pound
fusions.desc: Pounds the ground with fists and forehooves, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Hand Over Hoof
fusions.desc: Climbs you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away.

fusions.name: Grudge Match
fusions.desc: Every hit marks the target with a stack, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 17% of your weapon damage per stack (85% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
